subject: English
passage: Marine biologists Tadesse Hakim and Agus Menon have proposed that the tubeworms clustered around certain deep-sea hydrothermal vents can survive for more than 300 years. Such lengthy life spans mark these tubeworms as extreme outliers; ______ most marine invertebrates living near such vents complete their entire life cycles within just a few decades.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The first sentence claims the tubeworms' lifespans mark them as extreme outliers. The clause after the blank specifies the typical life span of most nearby marine invertebrates — just a few decades — which reinforces and elaborates the outlier claim by providing the benchmark that makes 300 years stand out. 'Indeed,' appropriately signals this kind of emphatic elaboration on the same idea.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. 'Therefore,' signals that the second clause is a result of the first, but the fact that most nearby marine invertebrates live only a few decades is not caused by the tubeworms being extreme outliers. Instead, that fact provides the benchmark that reinforces the outlier claim.
